infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Engine Eye uses Face ID so you can unlock your saved sign-in instead of typing your password. For example, tap Sign in with Face ID on the sign-in screen to get back to your saved diagnoses.

plugins.cameraPermission: Engine Eye uses your camera so you can take a photo of a dashboard warning light, a damaged part, or a printed repair estimate. The photo is analyzed by AI only after you agree on the permission screen. For example, photograph your check engine light to learn what it means.
plugins.photosPermission: Engine Eye reads only the photos you choose from your library, such as a screenshot of a repair quote or a picture of a damaged part, so AI can analyze them. For example, pick a photo of your mechanic's estimate to see which items look necessary or overpriced.
